Name: [SMOKE] sys_diag_tab — App launch and System Diagrams tab visibility
Precondition: Application is installed and all dependencies are available.
Objective: Verify that the application launches and the System Diagrams tab is visible and accessible.
Test Script (Step): Launch the Calibration Statistics Tool application (python main.py).
Test Script (Expected Result): Main window opens without errors; all tabs are visible.

Test Script (Step): Navigate to the System Diagrams tab in the main tab widget.
Test Script (Expected Result): System Diagrams tab is displayed with Input Setup, Plot Setup, Plot Window Configuration, and Slide Configuration group boxes visible.

Test Script (Step): Close the application.
Test Script (Expected Result): Application exits cleanly with no crash or error messages.

Name: [SMOKE] sys_diag_tab — Default configuration presentation run
Precondition: Application is launched; PTU2 files are available in measurement_data/ptu_files/; protocol files have been loaded via the Parse & Load tab.
Objective: Verify that the System Diagrams tab generates a PPTX presentation file with default settings.
Test Script (Step): In the Parse & Load tab load a folder of PTU2 measurement files.
Test Script (Step Data): measurement_data/ptu_files/ (folder with at least one valid PTU2 file)
Test Script (Expected Result): Status shows parsed file count; no error in log panel.

Test Script (Step): Switch to the System Diagrams tab. Verify default settings: Angle=Target Angle, Sensor Orientation=Normal, Chirp 1/2/3 checked, Diagram Configuration=All, Script Mode=Presentation, Image Generation=Rx-Channel, 3-Graph Layout checked.
Test Script (Expected Result): All default controls reflect the expected default state.

Test Script (Step): Click the Start button.
Test Script (Expected Result): Progress indication is shown; script runs without UI freeze; a log message 'PPTX file saved successfully' appears.

Test Script (Step): Inspect the output folder (output/) for the generated PPTX file.
Test Script (Expected Result): A .pptx file (e.g. Antenna_diagrams.pptx) is present; it contains a separation sheet, sensor list slide, and diagram slides.

Name: [SMOKE] sys_diag_tab — Interactive mode protocol table population
Precondition: Application is launched; PTU2 files have been parsed and loaded successfully.
Objective: Verify that the interactive protocol and parameter tables populate correctly after data is loaded.
Test Script (Step): After successful parse, navigate to the System Diagrams interactive sub-tab (tab index 8).
Test Script (Expected Result): Interactive sub-tab is visible with protocol and parameter tables.

Test Script (Step): Verify that the Protocol table contains rows corresponding to the loaded sensors (dateTime_tuner_sensor format).
Test Script (Expected Result): Protocol table is non-empty; each row shows a sensor measurement identifier and Graph column shows 'False'.

Test Script (Step): Verify the Parameter table contains rows for each graph type (level, normLevel, corrPhaseDiff, etc.) per Rx-channel per diagram.
Test Script (Expected Result): Parameter table is non-empty; each row shows a measurement name (e.g. levelAnt0_Diagram0) with Graph='Off' and Axis='ax1'.

Name: [SMOKE] sys_diag_tab — Empty data error handling
Precondition: Application is launched; no PTU2 files have been loaded (data list is empty).
Objective: Verify that starting the script without data produces an error slide in the output PPTX rather than a crash.
Test Script (Step): Do not load any PTU2 files. Navigate to the System Diagrams tab.
Test Script (Expected Result): No data in the parse list.

Test Script (Step): Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): Log panel shows 'No parsed PTU2 files found!' error message; application does not crash.

Test Script (Step): Inspect the output folder.
Test Script (Expected Result): A PPTX is generated containing a Warnings and Errors slide and a separation sheet; no diagram slides are present.

Name: [REGRESSION] sys_diag_tab — Angle Setup: Target Angle vs PTU Angle
Precondition: Application is launched; PTU2 files are loaded.
Objective: Verify that switching the Angle Setup radio button changes the x-axis label in the generated output from 'Target Angle [°]' to 'PTU Angle [°]'.
Test Script (Step): Select 'Target Angle' radio button in Input Setup → Angle Setup. Start the script.
Test Script (Expected Result): Generated diagram images use x-axis label 'Target Angle [°]'.

Test Script (Step): Select 'PTU Angle' radio button. Start the script again.
Test Script (Expected Result): Generated diagram images use x-axis label 'PTU Angle [°]'.

Name: [REGRESSION] sys_diag_tab — Sensor Orientation: Normal vs Upside-Down
Precondition: Application is launched; PTU2 files are loaded.
Objective: Verify that sensor orientation (Normal / Upside-Down) is applied to the plotted data.
Test Script (Step): Select 'Normal' sensor orientation, run Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX is generated; presentation title and log confirm 'Antenna system diagrams' processing completed.

Test Script (Step): Select 'Upside-Down' sensor orientation, run Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX is regenerated; log shows no error; diagram images reflect the inverted orientation.

Name: [REGRESSION] sys_diag_tab — Chirp Configuration: individual chirp selection
Precondition: Application is launched; PTU2 files with multiple chirps are loaded.
Objective: Verify that only data from the selected chirps is processed when specific chirp checkboxes are enabled.
Test Script (Step): Enable only Chirp 0 checkbox; disable Chirp 1, 2, 3.
Test Script (Expected Result): One chirp selected.

Test Script (Step): Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): Script completes; generated PPTX contains diagrams that correspond to Chirp 0 data only; log shows no error.

Test Script (Step): Re-enable all chirp checkboxes (0–3) and run Start again.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX is regenerated with data from all chirps; number of data curves increases accordingly.

Name: [REGRESSION] sys_diag_tab — Diagram Configuration: All diagrams
Precondition: Application launched; multiple-diagram PTU2 data is loaded.
Objective: Verify that selecting 'All' in Diagram Configuration includes every diagram number in the PPTX.
Test Script (Step): Select 'All' radio button under Diagram Configuration. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX contains slides for every available diagram number; log reports 'Configured graphs generated'.

Name: [REGRESSION] sys_diag_tab — Diagram Configuration: Desired range
Precondition: Application launched; multi-diagram PTU2 data is loaded.
Objective: Verify that selecting 'Desired range' limits diagrams in the output to the specified low–high range.
Test Script (Step): Select 'Desired range' radio button. Enter Low=2 and High=5 in the respective fields. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX contains only diagram slides for diagram numbers 2 through 5; no other diagram slides are present.

Name: [REGRESSION] sys_diag_tab — Diagram Configuration: Desired list
Precondition: Application launched; multi-diagram PTU2 data is loaded.
Objective: Verify that entering a comma-separated list of diagram numbers filters the output correctly.
Test Script (Step): Select 'Desired list' radio button. Enter '1,3,5' in the list input field. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX contains slides only for diagram numbers 1, 3, and 5.

Test Script (Step): Enter an invalid value (e.g. a non-numeric character) in the list input field.
Test Script (Expected Result): Input is rejected by the validator; field does not accept non-numeric characters; Start runs without crashing.

Name: [REGRESSION] sys_diag_tab — Graph Configuration: individual graph type checkboxes
Precondition: Application launched; PTU2 data loaded.
Objective: Verify that only the checked graph types (level, normLevel, corrPhaseDiff, etc.) are generated in the PPTX.
Test Script (Step): Uncheck all graph checkboxes. Check only 'Level [dB]'. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX diagram slides contain only level graphs; no corrPhaseDiff or other graph type slides are present.

Test Script (Step): Check 'Corr. Phase Diff. [°]' in addition. Click Start.
Test Script (Step Data): Graph Configuration: Level [dB] + Corr. Phase Diff. [°]
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX contains both level and corrected phase difference slides.

Test Script (Step): Uncheck all graph types and click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): Log shows 'No graphs configured!' error; PPTX may still be saved with separation/error slides only.

Name: [REGRESSION] sys_diag_tab — Image DPI field validation
Precondition: Application launched; PTU2 data loaded.
Objective: Verify that the Image DPI field accepts only integers in range 0–500 and that the configured DPI affects output image quality.
Test Script (Step): Enter '220' in the Image DPI field. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): Script runs; generated .png images in the output folder have DPI of 220.

Test Script (Step): Clear the field and enter '600' (out of range).
Test Script (Expected Result): Validator rejects the value (field stays at max 500); input is not accepted or is clamped.

Test Script (Step): Enter a non-numeric character.
Test Script (Expected Result): Validator rejects non-numeric input; Start does not use an invalid DPI.

Name: [REGRESSION] sys_diag_tab — Script Mode: Presentation vs Plot Window
Precondition: Application launched; PTU2 data loaded.
Objective: Verify that Script Mode 'Presentation' saves a PPTX and 'Plot Window' opens a plot window for a specific diagram.
Test Script (Step): Select 'Presentation' Script Mode. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX file is saved to the output folder; no interactive plot window is opened.

Test Script (Step): Select 'Plot Window' Script Mode. Configure Antenna Type, Diagram Number, Rx-Channel, and Graph Type in the Plot Window Configuration group. Click Start.
Test Script (Step Data): Antenna Type=158, Diagram Number=3, Rx-Channel=0, Graph Type=corrPhaseDiff
Test Script (Expected Result): A matplotlib plot window opens for the specified parameters; no PPTX file is saved.

Name: [REGRESSION] sys_diag_tab — Image Generation Mode: Rx-Channel vs Diagram Number
Precondition: Application launched; PTU2 data loaded; Script Mode=Presentation.
Objective: Verify that switching Image Generation Mode changes how graphs are grouped in the PPTX slides.
Test Script (Step): Select 'Rx-Channel' Image Generation Mode. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): Each PPTX slide groups all sensor measurements for one Rx-channel; slide titles include Rx-channel identifiers.

Test Script (Step): Select 'Diagram Number' Image Generation Mode. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX slides are grouped by diagram number; slide titles include diagram number identifiers.

Name: [REGRESSION] sys_diag_tab — 3-Graph Layout Images checkbox
Precondition: Application launched; PTU2 data loaded; Script Mode=Presentation; at least one Three-Graph Layout configuration is active.
Objective: Verify that disabling '3-Graph Layout Images' removes three-graph slides from the PPTX.
Test Script (Step): Check '3-Graph Layout Images' checkbox. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX contains three-graph layout slides for the configured graph types.

Test Script (Step): Uncheck '3-Graph Layout Images' checkbox. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX does not contain three-graph layout slides; other configured slides are still present.

Name: [REGRESSION] sys_diag_tab — Two-Graph Layout slide configuration
Precondition: Application launched; PTU2 data loaded; Script Mode=Presentation.
Objective: Verify that Two-Graph Layout Configuration 1 and Configuration 2 produce correct paired slides.
Test Script (Step): Enable 'Configuration 1' checkbox in Two-Graph Layout. Set ComboBox 1 to 'normLevel' and ComboBox 2 to 'level'. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX contains two-graph slides showing normLevel (large) and level (small) paired per diagram and Rx-channel.

Test Script (Step): Enable 'Configuration 2' checkbox. Set ComboBox to a different pair (e.g. corrPhaseDiff + diffPhaseDiff). Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX contains additional two-graph slides for the corrPhaseDiff/diffPhaseDiff pair.

Test Script (Step): Disable both Configuration 1 and Configuration 2 checkboxes. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): No two-graph layout slides appear in the PPTX.

Name: [REGRESSION] sys_diag_tab — Three-Graph Layout slide configuration
Precondition: Application launched; PTU2 data loaded; Script Mode=Presentation; 3-Graph Layout Images checkbox is enabled.
Objective: Verify that Three-Graph Layout configurations produce correct three-image slides.
Test Script (Step): Enable Configuration 1 in Three-Graph Layout; set ComboBox to 'corrPhaseDiff'. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX contains three-graph slides with three corrPhaseDiff images per slide.

Test Script (Step): Enable Configuration 2 with 'phaseDiff'. Enable Configuration 3 with 'diffPhaseDiff'. Click Start.
Test Script (Step Data): Three-Graph Config 1: corrPhaseDiff; Config 2: phaseDiff; Config 3: diffPhaseDiff
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX contains three sets of three-graph slides (one set per configuration); slide captions show correct diagram and frequency info.

Name: [REGRESSION] sys_diag_tab — Four-Graph Layout slide configuration
Precondition: Application launched; PTU2 data loaded; Script Mode=Presentation.
Objective: Verify that Four-Graph Layout configurations produce four-image slides in the PPTX.
Test Script (Step): Enable 'Configuration 1' in Four-Graph Layout; set ComboBox to 'level'. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX contains four-graph layout slides with four level diagrams per slide.

Test Script (Step): Disable all Four-Graph Layout configurations. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): No four-graph layout slides appear in the PPTX.

Name: [REGRESSION] sys_diag_tab — All-Graphs Slide configuration
Precondition: Application launched; PTU2 data loaded; Script Mode=Presentation.
Objective: Verify that the All-Graphs Slide checkbox controls generation of the all-on-one-slide image.
Test Script (Step): Enable 'All-Graphs Slide' checkbox. Configure Graph 1=level, Graph 2=corrPhaseDiff, Graph 3=diffPhaseDiff. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX contains an all-on-one-slide image slide; the slide caption lists all configured graph types; the embedded image file 'all_on_one_slide.png' is present in the output folder.

Test Script (Step): Uncheck 'All-Graphs Slide'. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): No all-on-one-slide image slide is present in the PPTX.

Name: [REGRESSION] sys_diag_tab — Interactive protocol table toggle
Precondition: Application launched; PTU2 data loaded; interactive sub-tab (tab 8) is visible with a populated protocol table.
Objective: Verify that clicking the Graph cell of a protocol row toggles the sensor measurement visibility in the interactive plot.
Test Script (Step): In the interactive tab, click the Graph cell of the first protocol row (initial state: 'False').
Test Script (Expected Result): Cell background turns green, text changes to 'True'; all parameter table rows belonging to this sensor are plotted on the canvas.

Test Script (Step): Click the same Graph cell again.
Test Script (Expected Result): Cell background returns to white, text changes to 'False'; the sensor's lines are removed from the canvas; canvas is redrawn.

Name: [REGRESSION] sys_diag_tab — Interactive parameter table cell: toggle On/Off
Precondition: Application launched; PTU2 data loaded; interactive sub-tab visible; at least one protocol is enabled (graph=True).
Objective: Verify that clicking the Graph cell of a parameter table row toggles the individual data line on and off.
Test Script (Step): Click the Graph cell (column 0) of a parameter table row (initial state: 'Off').
Test Script (Expected Result): Cell background turns green, text changes to 'On'; the corresponding line is drawn on the interactive canvas (ax1 or ax2); canvas updates.

Test Script (Step): Click the same cell again.
Test Script (Expected Result): Cell background returns to white, text changes to 'Off'; the line is removed from the canvas; y-axis rescaling occurs; canvas is redrawn.

Name: [REGRESSION] sys_diag_tab — Interactive parameter table: axis switch (ax1 ↔ ax2)
Precondition: Application launched; PTU2 data loaded; interactive sub-tab visible; at least one parameter row is in 'On' state plotted on ax1.
Objective: Verify that clicking the Axis cell of an active parameter row moves the line from ax1 to ax2 and vice versa.
Test Script (Step): Ensure a parameter row has Graph='On' and Axis='ax1' (text blue).
Test Script (Expected Result): Row shows Axis='ax1', text color blue.

Test Script (Step): Click the Axis cell (column 1) of that row.
Test Script (Step Data): Axis cell of the active row
Test Script (Expected Result): Axis cell text changes to 'ax2' (red); the line is removed from ax1 and re-plotted on ax2; canvas is redrawn.

Test Script (Step): Click the Axis cell again.
Test Script (Expected Result): Axis switches back to 'ax1' (blue); line moves from ax2 to ax1; canvas is redrawn.

Name: [REGRESSION] sys_diag_tab — Interactive Turn On/Off button
Precondition: Application launched; PTU2 data loaded; interactive sub-tab visible with multiple protocol rows.
Objective: Verify that the Turn On/Off button toggles the Graph state of all protocol rows simultaneously.
Test Script (Step): Ensure multiple protocol rows are in 'False' state. Click the 'Turn On/Off' button.
Test Script (Expected Result): All protocol rows switch state; rows previously 'False' become 'True' (green) and their parameter lines are rendered on the canvas.

Test Script (Step): Click 'Turn On/Off' again.
Test Script (Expected Result): All rows toggle back to the opposite state; canvas updates accordingly.

Name: [REGRESSION] sys_diag_tab — Interactive Clear Data button
Precondition: Application launched; PTU2 data loaded; interactive sub-tab has populated tables and plotted lines.
Objective: Verify that clicking Clear Data removes all table content and resets the interactive plot.
Test Script (Step): Enable several protocol and parameter rows so the canvas shows multiple lines. Click the 'Clear Data' button (SysDiaInterClrGrBtn).
Test Script (Expected Result): Protocol table is cleared (0 rows); Parameter table is cleared (0 rows); the interactive canvas is reset (no lines); RePlot data structure is empty.

Name: [REGRESSION] sys_diag_tab — Y-Limits Yield: Per Antenna-Type vs All Antenna-Types
Precondition: Application launched; PTU2 data from multiple antenna types is loaded; Script Mode=Presentation.
Objective: Verify that Y-Limits Yield 'Per Antenna-Type' and 'All Antenna-Types' produce different y-axis scaling in the generated diagrams.
Test Script (Step): Select 'Per Antenna-Type' radio button in Y-Limits Yield. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX diagrams use y-axis limits calculated per antenna type; graphs for different antenna types may use different y ranges.

Test Script (Step): Select 'All Antenna-Types' radio button. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): PPTX diagrams use a unified y-axis scale across all antenna types; the y range is consistent across slides for different antenna types.

Name: [REGRESSION] sys_diag_tab — X-Scale Autoscale vs manual azimuth/elevation
Precondition: Application launched; PTU2 data loaded; Script Mode=Presentation.
Objective: Verify that X-Scale Autoscale disables manual azimuth/elevation x-scale input, and that manual values are applied when autoscale is off.
Test Script (Step): Check 'X-Scale Autoscale'. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): x-axis range in diagrams is auto-determined from data; the manual X-Scale Azimuth and Elevation fields have no effect.

Test Script (Step): Uncheck 'X-Scale Autoscale'. Enter X-Scale Azimuth=60 and X-Scale Elevation=30. Click Start.
Test Script (Expected Result): x-axis of azimuth diagrams spans ±60°; elevation diagrams span ±30°; PPTX images reflect these limits.
